title: Agent Bridge mailbox message
description: One JSON file under <project>/.agent-bridge/mailbox/{unclaimed,claimed,done}/<id>.json. Authoritative shape — bridge.js validates every message it writes against this before touching disk.

id.description: UUID for this message file. Also the filename (without .json).

from.description: Name of the agent that sent this message, e.g. "claude", "codex", "chatgpt", "gemini".

to.description: Name of the agent this message is addressed to.

type.description: ask/delegate/review = requests the recipient should act on. result/status/error = replies about a prior taskId.

content.description: Human-readable summary of the request or reply.

files.description: Paths (relative to projectPath) relevant to this message.

taskId.description: Correlates a request with its reply(ies). Stable across an ask/delegate -> result/review/status/error thread.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project this mailbox belongs to.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. new Date().toISOString().
